label: 3. Counselor, do you know of any places

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Counselor, do you know of any places

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: that have a bunch of bottle caps?
The garbage dumb.
My room.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I've already searched that place up and down.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Enough plastic bottles to last two lifetimes, but no caps.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: You mean the Commander's Room?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Are there many bottle caps there?
Yep, because I drink a lot of soda.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Ah, so you drink soda often?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Save the bottle caps for me then.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I'll come get them later.
Are you running low on bottle caps?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: But you can never have too many.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Think of it this way: you can never have too many credits, right?
Right.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Well, it's the same basic idea.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: In the Rehabilitation Center, bottle caps are our currency.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: So, if you save up a lot of extra bottle caps,

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: remember to contact me.
Got it.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Thanks!
